## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: cyclicals (Energy, Industrials, Financials) are posting net gains while Technology and Healthcare lag, and Leadership is Narrow (3/5 Communication), supporting a mixed/neutral read.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Communication leads: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +6.01% | 1M: -3.23%) RECOVERY. Energy strong: CVX (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +29.96%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -11.53% | 1M: -25.38%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare weak: UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -10.23% | 1M: -5.91%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary showing pockets of weakness with TSLA (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.29%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +7.53% | 1M: -1.66%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.31% | 1M: +6.97%) CORRECTION, TMO (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -0.83%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +9.93%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in high‑multiple Tech and select Healthcare names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
1W leaders: VZ (1W: +12.65%), TXN (1W: +12.23%), T (1W: +11.11%), META (1W: +8.76%), LMT (1W: +7.35%) — all showing strong 1W follow‑through. Major divergence: multiple large caps (AAPL, JPM, MA, TMUS, CHTR) show 1W vs 1M mismatch indicating a MAJOR DIVERGENCE — watch for trend break and treat moves as tactical, not necessarily sustained.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-soft; large-cap dispersion is high with NVDA (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.91%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +3.07% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND and META ABOVE TREND while MSFT, ORCL, INTU, NOW are BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Tech: 6/19 positive. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given breadth weakness despite a few strong names.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Cautious constructive; JPM (1W: +2.74% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY and MA (1W: +2.68% | 1M: -6.55%) RECOVERY show short‑term buying while broader Financials are modestly positive. Sector breadth: Financials: 13/20 positive. Style: Value/Cyclical favored alongside Energy and Industrials.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive cracks appearing; JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +3.08% | 1M: +7.57%) ABOVE TREND offset deep weakness in UNH and CVS. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 5/15 positive — monitor earnings/Medicare headlines for follow‑through.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals and quality defensives within leading sectors: select Energy (XOM, CVX) and Industrials (CAT, LMT) exposure, and favored Financials where pickup exists; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names that remain BELOW TREND (MSFT, ORCL, INTU). Style: Value over Growth given breadth and leadership concentration; monitor major divergence for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND — watch buyback execution and Frontier deal flow, JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND on FDA approval news, TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND on momentum. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Communication (breadth strong; Communication: 6/7 positive), Energy (Energy: 7/8 positive), Industrials (Industrials: 9/13 positive) — watch earnings/news cadence. BEARISH: Technology (Tech: 6/19 positive) and Healthcare (Healthcare: 5/15 positive) for downside follow‑through and headline risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.91%) ABOVE TREND — sustained break above recent 1M highs would confirm broader tech participation; MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim the 1M downtrend keeps it at risk; VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND — watch buyback/cost‑cutting execution as trigger for continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
VZ (+85): Verizon resets story with Frontier deal and $25b buyback — VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, price confirming bullish news but note mixed headlines. JNJ (+80): Myeloma approval drives JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. LMT (+55): Missile deal and new ventures support LMT (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +29.96%) ABOVE TREND, price confirms.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (-55): Earnings shock/Medicare strain — UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed by sharp sell‑off. CVS (-50): Antitrust scrutiny — CVS (1W: -10.23% | 1M: -5.91%) BELOW TREND, price confirming. VZ (-55): CEO pricing admission headline conflicts with VZ (+85) bullish item — VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, price diverges from some negative headlines so monitor for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value over Growth. VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (MSFT, AAPL, JPM, MA, TMUS) and mixed sentiment (VZ bullish and bearish headlines) — watch for trend confirmation before reallocating.
